changelog:
Initial release: Connect your agent to the Agensi AI skill marketplace via MCP.

- Search, discover, and browse SKILL.md skills from agensi.io directly in your terminal
- Supports searching by keyword, category, or tag, and fetching full skill details
- Browse most popular skills, all categories, and creator profiles
- View unbuilt community-requested skills
- Simple setup instructions for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and all SSE-based MCP agents
